This file documents the suppliers resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =suppliers=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

* Commands

** =list=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 1DE1CC78-8568-5F52-B9D9-91A6495D97FA
:END:

Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
suppliers list [--offset <n>] [--limit <n>] [--order <field>] [--desc]
#+end_example

It is addressed at =marketdata.v1.suppliers.list=.

#+name: suppliers-list
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle suppliers-list.ores :exports none
suppliers list --limit 1
#+end_src

** =get=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: FD50E100-AF63-5A71-B603-032C521A1AB1
:END:

Reads the one row its key addresses. A key states every identifying column, so a partial key is refused rather than answered with an arbitrary row.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
suppliers get <code>
#+end_example

It is addressed at =marketdata.v1.suppliers.get=.

#+name: suppliers-get
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle suppliers-get.ores :exports none
suppliers get __none__
#+end_src
